examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ saṅghaṭṭā samodhānā usmā jāyati, tejo abhinibbattati, tesaṃ'y'eva dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ nānābhāvā vikkhepā yā tajjā usmā sā nirujjhati, sā vūpasammati.

57005.meaning2: close contact, knocking against, impingement, knocking together

57006.commentary: (SNa) saṅghaṭṭanasamodhānā'ti saṅghaṭṭanena c'eva samodhānena ca, saṅghaṭṭanasampiṇḍanenā'ti attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ saṅghaṭṭanasamodhānā usmā jāyati tejo abhinibbattati.

57007.meaning1: knocking together; rubbing together; colliding; smashing

examples.text: so n'ātidūre pādaṃ uddharati, n'āccāsanne pādaṃ nikkhipati, so n'ātisīghaṃ gacchati, n'ātisaṇikaṃ gacchati, na ca adduvena adduvaṃ saṅghaṭṭento gacchati, na ca gopphakena gopphakaṃ saṅghaṭṭento gacchati.

57008.meaning1: from the community; from the assembly of monks
57008.commentary: (VINa) saṅghato vā'ti attano pattabhāgavasena saṅghato vā uppajjeyya.

examples.text: uppajjeyyā'ti uppajjeyya saṅghato vā gaṇato vā ñātito vā mittato vā paṃsukūlaṃ vā attano vā dhanena.

57011.meaning1: most junior monk in the community

examples.text: apattakassa na gāhetabbo. eten'eva upāyena yāva saṅghanavakā gāhetabbā.

57012.meaningLit: for the sake of inviting the community
57012.construction:
saṅgha + nimantana + attha + āya
saṅghanimantanattha + āya

57013.commentary: (ANa) pitiṭṭhāne ṭhitattā saṅghaṃ pariṇenti, pubbaṅ'gamā hutvā tīsu sikkhāsu pavattentī'ti saṅghapariṇāyakā.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu… na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti, anavasesadohī ca hoti, ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.
yāvakīvañ'ca bhikkhave bhikkhū ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā te sakkarissanti garuṃ karissanti mānessanti pūjessanti tesañ'ca sotabbaṃ maññissanti

57014.meaning1: accompanied by a multitude; surrounded by an entourage

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, aññatarā tāvatiṃsakāyikā devatā nandane vane accharāsaṅghaparivutā dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricāriyamānā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi
tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadah'uposathe pannarase puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto abbhokāse nisinno hoti.

57015.meaning1: father of the community; community elder

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu… na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti, anavasesadohī ca hoti, ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.
yāvakīvañ'ca bhikkhave bhikkhū ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā te sakkarissanti garuṃ karissanti mānessanti pūjessanti tesañ'ca sotabbaṃ maññissanti

57016.meaning1: connected with the Saṅgha; regarding the community

examples.text: ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ, buddhappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, dhammappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, saṅghappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoññātaṃ anavaññātaṃ ahīḷitaṃ aparibhūtaṃ cittīkataṃ, etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ.

57017.meaning1: comfort of the community; ease within the monastic order

examples.text: tena hi, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññapessāmi dasa atthavase paṭicca, saṅghasuṭṭhutāya, saṅghaphāsutāya, dummaṅkūnaṃ puggalānaṃ niggahāya, pesalānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phāsuvihārāya, diṭṭhadhammikānaṃ āsavānaṃ saṃvarāya, samparāyikānaṃ āsavānaṃ paṭighātāya, appasannānaṃ pasādāya, pasannānaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya, saddhammaṭṭhitiyā, vinay'ānuggahāya.

57019.meaning1: splitting apart of the community; schism in the monastic order

examples.text: m'āyasmantānam'pi saṅghabhedo ruccittha, samet'āyasmantānaṃ saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ek'uddeso phāsu viharatī'ti.

57020.meaning1: schismatic; who causes dissension in the community; who causes the monastic order to break apart
57020.meaning2: who causes dissension in the community of monks

examples.text: so bhikkhū'ti yo so saṅghabhedako bhikkhu.

57022.meaning1: rule about schism in the community; Saṅghādisesa 10

57026.meaning2: community property; wealth of the Saṅgha

57027.meaning1: amidst the community; middle of the monastic order

examples.text: so bhikkhu saṅghamajjham'pi ākaḍḍhitvā vattabbo, m'āyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya

57028.grammar: ind, adv, comp, loc sg of saṅghamajjha
57028.meaning1: in the midst of the community; among the monastic order

examples.text: yadāyasmantānaṃ pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ yā c'eva āyasmantānaṃ āpatti, yā ca attano āpatti, āyasmantānañc'eva atthāya, attano ca atthāya, saṅghamajjhe tiṇ'avatthārakena deseyyaṃ, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ, ṭhapetvā gihippaṭisaṃyuttan'ti.
yaṃ jātaṃ taṃ saṅghamajjhe pucchante santaṃ atthī'ti vattabbaṃ asantaṃ n'atthī'ti vattabbaṃ

57030.meaning1: daughter of King Asoka; establisher of the community of nuns in Sri Lanka
57030.meaning2: daughter of King Asoka who established Bhikkhunī Saṅgha in Sri Lanka

examples.text: tena ca samayena rājadhītā saṅghamittā'pi tasmiṃ'y'eva ṭhāne ṭhitā hoti. tassā ca sāmiko aggibrahmā nāma kumāro yuvarājena tissakumārena saddhiṃ pabbajito hoti.

57031.meaning1: generic monk's name used in vinaya examples

57033.meaning1: treasure of the Saṅgha; jewel that is the community
57033.commentary: (MNa) evaṃ ekadesena dhammaguṇe likhitvā tatiyaṃ saṅgharatanaṃ thomento, suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho… puññakkhettaṃ lokassā'ti.

examples.text: yesaṃ atthi saddhā buddhe, dhamme ca saṅgharatane, te maṃ ativirocanti, āyunā yasasā siriyā.

57034.commentary: (VINa) evam'pi kho upāli saṅgharāji hoti, no ca saṅghabhedo'ti ettāvatā hi saṅgharājimattam'eva hoti, na tāva saṅghabhedo, anupubbena pana ayaṃ saṅgharāji vaḍḍhamānā saṅghabhedāya saṃvattatī'ti attho.

examples.text: anāpatti ajānanto pucchati, gilāno vā na katheti, saṅghassa bhaṇḍanaṃ vā kalaho vā viggaho vā vivādo vā bhavissatī'ti na katheti, saṅghabhedo vā saṅgharāji vā bhavissatī'ti na katheti, adhammena vā vaggena vā nakamm'ārahassa vā kammaṃ karissatī'ti na katheti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

57035.meaning1: (of a harvest) causes to collect; makes gather

examples.text: tam'enaṃ kassako gahapati sīghaṃ sīghaṃ lavāpeyya. sīghaṃ sīghaṃ lavāpetvā sīghaṃ sīghaṃ saṅgharāpeyya. sīghaṃ sīghaṃ saṅgharāpetvā sīghaṃ sīghaṃ ubbahāpeyya.

57036.meaning1: (of a harvest) having caused to collect; having made gather

examples.text: tam'enaṃ kassako gahapati sīghaṃ sīghaṃ lavāpeyya. sīghaṃ sīghaṃ lavāpetvā sīghaṃ sīghaṃ saṅgharāpeyya. sīghaṃ sīghaṃ saṅgharāpetvā sīghaṃ sīghaṃ ubbahāpeyya.

57037.meaning1: having collected; having gathered; having accumulated

examples.text: so yadeva tattha honti tiṇāni vā paṇṇāni vā tāni ekajjhaṃ saṅgharitvā nisīdāmi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.

57038.commentary: (MNa) bahū bahū hutvā saṃhatā'ti saṅghā. ek'ekissā disāya saṅgho tesaṃ atthī'ti saṅghī.

examples.text: atha kho opāsādakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā opāsādā nikkhamitvā saṅghasaṅghī gaṇībhūtā uttarenamukhā gacchanti yena devavanaṃ sālavanaṃ.
sādhu kho, devānam'inda, saṅghasaraṇagamanaṃ hoti. saṅghasaraṇagamanahetu kho, devānam'inda, evam'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantī'ti.

57041.meaning1: because of taking refuge in the Saṅgha

examples.text: sādhu kho, devānam'inda, saṅghasaraṇagamanaṃ hoti. saṅghasaraṇagamanahetu kho, devānam'inda, evam'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantī'ti.

57044.meaning1: well-being of the community; prosperity of the monastic order
57044.commentary: (VINa) saṅghasuṭṭhutā nāma saṅghassa suṭṭhubhāvo, suṭṭhu devā'ti āgataṭṭhāne viya suṭṭhu, bhante'ti vacanasampaṭicchanabhāvo. yo ca tathāgatassa vacanaṃ sampaṭicchati, tassa taṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya hoti, tasmā saṅghassa suṭṭhu, bhante'ti mama vacanasampaṭicchanatthaṃ paññapessāmi, asampaṭicchane ādīnavaṃ sampaṭicchane ca ānisaṃsaṃ dassetvā, na balakkārena abhibhavitvā'ti etam'atthaṃ āvikaronto āha, saṅghasuṭṭhutāyā'ti.

examples.text: tena hi, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññapessāmi dasa atthavase paṭicca, saṅghasuṭṭhutāya, saṅghaphāsutāya, dummaṅkūnaṃ puggalānaṃ niggahāya, pesalānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phāsuvihārāya, diṭṭhadhammikānaṃ āsavānaṃ saṃvarāya, samparāyikānaṃ āsavānaṃ paṭighātāya, appasannānaṃ pasādāya, pasannānaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya, saddhammaṭṭhitiyā, vinay'ānuggahāya.

57045.meaning1: frequented by group; visited by herds

examples.text: mah'odadhiṃ aparimitaṃ mahāsaraṃ, bahubheravaṃ ratanagaṇānam'ālayaṃ, najjo yathā naragaṇasaṅghasevitā, puthū savantī upayanti sāgaraṃ.
vāḷamigasaṅghasevitaṃ, kuñjaramattakareṇuloḷitaṃ, asahāyikā gantum'icchasi, rahitaṃ bhiṃsanakaṃ mahāvanaṃ.

57046.meaning1: adorning the community; beautifying the monastic order

examples.text: yo hoti viyatto ca visārado ca, bahussuto dhammadharo ca hoti, dhammassa hoti anudhammacārī, sa tādiso vuccati saṅghasobhano.
bhikkhu ca sīlasampanno, bhikkhunī ca bahussutā, upāsako ca yo saddho, yā ca saddhā upāsikā, ete kho saṅghaṃ sobhenti, ete hi saṅghasobhanā'ti.

57047.meaningLit: for the sake of the saṅgha

57049.commentary: (VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: jātaṃ bhūtaṃ samuppannaṃ, kataṃ saṅkhatam'addhuvaṃ, jarāmaraṇasaṅghāṭaṃ, roganīḷaṃ pabhaṅguraṃ.
ahu kho so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ ānakassa mudiṅgassa porāṇaṃ pokkharaphalakaṃ antaradhāyi, āṇisaṅghāṭo'va avasissi.
gacchām'ahaṃ, bhante, samaṇassa gotamassa vādaṃ āropessāmī'ti gantvā mahatā'si vādasaṅghāṭena paṭimukko āgato.

57053.meaning1: which binds together; which joins (the others) together

examples.text: imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, channaṃ sāraṇīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ etaṃ aggaṃ etaṃ saṅgāhikaṃ etaṃ saṅghāṭanikaṃ, yadidaṃ y'āyaṃ diṭṭhi ariyā niyyānikā niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāya.

57054.meaning1: outer robe; double robe; patchwork robe
57054.meaning2: upper robe of a Buddhist monk

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā aṅgulimālo bhinnena sīsena, lohitena gaḷantena, bhinnena pattena, vipphālitāya saṅghāṭiyā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami
muṭṭhīhi'pi yujjhanti, raṅgamajjhe'pi saṅghāṭiṃ pattharitvā naccakiṃ evaṃ vadanti, idha, bhagini, naccassū'ti, nalāṭikam'pi denti, vividham'pi anācāraṃ ācaranti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, matajaṃ nāma āvudhajātaṃ ubhatodhāraṃ pītanisitaṃ. tadassa saṅghāṭiyā sampārutaṃ sampaliveṭhitaṃ. tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imassa bhikkhuno pabbajjaṃ vadāmi.

57056.meaning1: ascetic who wears a patchwork robe; patchwork robe wearer

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, saṅghāṭikassa saṅghāṭidhāraṇamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi.
ehi tvaṃ, bhadramukha, saṅghāṭiko hohi, saṅghāṭikassa te sato saṅghāṭidhāraṇamattena abhijjhālussa abhijjhā pahīyissati

57057.meaning1: holding the edge of the outer robe
57057.commentary: (KVt) tathā saṅghāṭikaṇṇaggahaṇan'ti na kevalaṃ saṅghāṭikaṇṇass'eva gahaṇaṃ, atha kho tassa ca aññassa'pi yassa kassaci cīvarappadesassa gahaṇaṃ vuttan'ti dassetuṃ ettha ca yassa kassacī'ti-ādi vuttaṃ.

57059.meaning1: fact of being an ascetic who wears a patchwork robe; state of being a patchwork robe wearer
57059.construction:
saṃ + √ghaṭ > ghāṭ + *i + ka + tta
saṅghāṭika + tta

examples.text: tam'enaṃ mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā jātam'eva naṃ saṅghāṭikaṃ kareyyuṃ, saṅghāṭikattam'eva samādapeyyuṃ, ehi tvaṃ, bhadramukha, saṅghāṭiko hohi, saṅghāṭikassa te sato saṅghāṭidhāraṇamattena abhijjhālussa abhijjhā pahīyissati

57060.commentary: (VINa) saṅghāṭīnaṃ cāro saṅghāṭicāro, paribhogavasena vā otāpanavasena vā saṅghaṭit'aṭṭhena saṅghāṭī'ti laddhanāmānaṃ pañcannaṃ cīvarānaṃ parivattanan'ti attho.

57062.meaning1: wearing an outer robe; using a patchwork robe

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, saṅghāṭikassa saṅghāṭidhāraṇamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi. n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, acelakassa acelakamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi. n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, rajojallikassa rajojallikamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi.
ehi tvaṃ, bhadramukha, saṅghāṭiko hohi, saṅghāṭikassa te sato saṅghāṭidhāraṇamattena abhijjhālussa abhijjhā pahīyissati

57063.meaning1: mere fact of wearing an outer robe; only by wearing a patchwork robe

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, saṅghāṭikassa saṅghāṭidhāraṇamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi. n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, acelakassa acelakamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi. n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, rajojallikassa rajojallikamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi.
ehi tvaṃ, bhadramukha, saṅghāṭiko hohi, saṅghāṭikassa te sato saṅghāṭidhāraṇamattena abhijjhālussa abhijjhā pahīyissati

57064.meaning1: taking the outer robe and bowl

57065.compound: dvanda (saṅghāṭi ca patta ca cīvara ca)

examples.text: evaṃ te abhikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te paṭikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te āloketabbaṃ, evaṃ te viloketabbaṃ, evaṃ te samiñjitabbaṃ, evaṃ te pasāritabbaṃ, evaṃ te saṅghāṭipattacīvaraṃ dhāretabban'ti.
samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī, asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī

57066.meaning1: carrying the outer robe, bowl and robe
57066.commentary: (MNa) saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe'ti ettha saṅghāṭicīvarānaṃ nivāsanapārupanavasena pattassa bhikkhā-paṭiggahaṇ'ādi-vasena paribhogo dhāraṇaṃ nāma.

examples.text: so abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī ahosiṃ

57067.meaning1: sitting posture with the outer robe clasped around the knees

57068.commentary: (THa) saṅghāṭipāruto'ti saṅghāṭiṃ pārupitvā nisinno. saṅghāṭiyā supāruto'ti ca paṭhan'ti. (THIa) muṇḍā saṅghāṭipārutā'ti muṇḍitakesā saṅghāṭipārutasarīrā ca hutvā pabbajitā'ti attho.

examples.text: rukkhamūlaṃ'va nissāya, muṇḍo saṅghāṭipāruto, paññāya uttamo thero, upatisso'va jhāyati.
sā'jja piṇḍaṃ caritvāna, muṇḍā saṅghāṭipārutā, nisinnā rukkhamūlamhi, avitakkassa lābhinī.

57069.commentary: (VINa) saṅghāṭīnaṃ cāro saṅghāṭicāro, paribhogavasena vā otāpanavasena vā saṅghaṭit'aṭṭhena saṅghāṭī'ti laddhanāmānaṃ pañcannaṃ cīvarānaṃ parivattanan'ti attho.

57070.meaning1: hip-chain; jewelled chain for the waist
57070.commentary: (KVa) saṅghāṇin'ti yaṃkiñci kaṭ'ūpagaṃ. (KVt) saṅghāṇin'ti kaṭiyaṃ anubhavitabbaṃ ābharaṇaṃ. ten'āha yaṃ kiñci kaṭ'ūpagan'ti. (VVt) saṅghāṇi nāma mekhal'ādikaṭipiḷandhanaṃ.

examples.text: tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ naditvā gocarāya pakkamati. taṃ kissa hetu? m'āhaṃ khuddake pāṇe visamagate saṅghātaṃ āpādesin'ti!

57073.synonym: kāya, saṅgaṇa, saṅgāha, sañcaya, saṇḍa, samussaya, samūha

examples.text: yadā dukkhass'āvahaniṃ visattikaṃ, papañca-saṅghāta-dukh'ādhivāhiniṃ, taṇhaṃ pahantvāna sato'va jhāyati, tato ratiṃ paramataraṃ na vindati.
aṭṭhisaṅghātaghaṭito, nhārusuttanibandhano, n'ekesaṃ saṃgatībhāvā, kappeti iriyāpathaṃ.

57074.commentary: (ANa) antamaso accharāsaṅghāta-mattam'pī'ti. sabb'antimena paricchedena dve aṅguliyo ekato katvā paharaṇamattam'pi kālan'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (THIa) n'āccharāsaṅghāta-mattam'pī'ti accharāghaṭitamattam'pi khaṇaṃ aṅguliphoṭanamattam'pi kālan'ti attho.

examples.text: paṇṇavīsativassāni, yato pabbajitā ahaṃ, n'āccharā-saṅghāta-mattam'pi, cittass'ūpasam'ajjhagaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, appamattako'pi gūtho duggandho hoti, evam'evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, appamattakam'pi bhavaṃ na vaṇṇemi, antamaso accharāsaṅghāta-mattam'pi.

saddhābalaṃ, hirībalaṃ, ottappabalaṃ, vīriyabalaṃ, paññābalaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca sekhabalāni. imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ sekhabalānaṃ etaṃ aggaṃ etaṃ saṅgāhikaṃ etaṃ saṅghātaniyaṃ, yadidaṃ paññābalaṃ.
so abhikkamanto paṭikkamanto bahū khuddake pāṇe saṅghātaṃ āpādeti. imassa pana, gahapati, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto kaṃ vipākaṃ paññapetī'ti?

57078.meaning1: to amass; to accumulate; to collect

examples.text: theyyena kūṭakammena, musāvādena c'ūbhayaṃ, kusalo hoti saṅghātuṃ, kāmabhogī ca mānavo, ito so nirayaṃ gantvā, ekacakkhu vihaññati.

57080.meaning1: related to an offence requiring communal rehabilitation; related to an offence entailing demotion
57080.meaningLit: related to an offence requiring involvement of the community from start to finish
57080.commentary: (VINa) vacan'attho pan'ettha saṅgho ādimhi c'eva sese ca icchitabbo assā'ti saṅgh'ādiseso.

examples.text: ime kho pan'āyasmanto terasa saṅgh'ādisesā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.

nisajjaṃ bhikkhu paṭijānamāno tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena kāretabbo pārājikena vā saṅgh'ādisesena vā pācittiyena vā, yena vā sā saddheyyavacasā upāsikā vadeyya, tena so bhikkhu kāretabbo, ayaṃ dhammo aniyato.

57081.meaning1: offence requiring communal rehabilitation; offence entailing demotion
57081.meaningLit: offence requiring involvement of the community from start to finish
57081.commentary: (VIN 6.8.5) saṅgh'ādiseso'ti yaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ suṇohi yathātathaṃ, saṅgho'va deti parivāsaṃ, mūlāya paṭikassati, mānattaṃ deti abbheti, ten'etaṃ iti vuccati.

examples.text: sañcetanikā sukkavissaṭṭhi aññatra supin'antā saṅgh'ādiseso.
tass'eva āpattinikāyassa nāmakammaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tena'pi vuccati, saṅgh'ādiseso'ti.

57082.meaning1: section on offences requiring communal rehabilitation

57083.meaning1: believing (something) to be an offence requiring communal rehabilitation

57085.meaning1: majestic power of the Saṅgha; magnificence of the community

57086.meaning1: recollection of (the qualities of) the community

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno saṅgh'ānussatiṃ bhāveti.

57087.commentary: (VMVt) sabbaṃ saṅgh'ārāmaṃ āvaraṇaṃ karontī'ti sabbasaṅgh'ārāme pavesanivāraṇaṃ karonti. saṅgh'ārāmo āvaraṇaṃ kātabbo'ti saṅgh'ārāmo āvaraṇo kātabbo, saṅgh'ārāme vā āvaraṇaṃ kātabban'ti attho.

examples.text: āgatā samaṇā imaṃ saṅgh'ārāmaṃ so'yaṃ āgatasamaṇo, saṅgh'ārāmo.
tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū sāmaṇerānaṃ sabbaṃ saṅgh'ārāmaṃ āvaraṇaṃ karonti. sāmaṇerā ārāmaṃ pavisituṃ alabhamānā pakkamanti'pi, vibbhamanti'pi, titthiyesu'pi saṅkamanti.

57088.commentary: (VIN 1.4.3.10) saṅghikaṃ nāma saṅghassa dinnaṃ hoti pariccattaṃ. (VINa) saṅghikan'ti saṅghassa santakaṃ.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu saṅghikaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā bhisiṃ vā kocchaṃ vā ajjhokāse santharitvā vā santharāpetvā vā taṃ pakkamanto n'eva uddhareyya, na uddharāpeyya, anāpucchaṃ vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ.

57090.meaning1: perceiving (something) as belonging to the community

57091.meaning1: having a following; with a community

examples.text: ye'pi te, bho gotama, samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇ'ācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa, seyyath'idaṃ, pūraṇo kassapo, makkhali gosālo, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto, sañcayo belaṭṭhaputto, pakudho kaccāyano, ajito kesakambalo

n'āhaṃ taṃ passāmi samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, saṅghiṃ gaṇiṃ gaṇ'ācariyaṃ, api arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ paṭijānamānaṃ, yo mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho na saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya, yassa na kacchehi sedā mucceyyuṃ.
accharāgaṇasaṅghuṭṭhaṃ, pisācagaṇasevitaṃ, van'antaṃ mohanaṃ nāma, kathaṃ yātrā bhavissatī'ti.

57093.meaning1: attending on the community; serving the Saṅgha
57093.commentary: (ANa) saṅgh'upaṭṭhākānan'ti bhikkhusaṅghassa upaṭṭhākānaṃ hatthigāmako uggato gahapati, aggo'ti dasseti.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ saṅgh'upaṭṭhākānaṃ yadidaṃ hatthigāmako uggato gahapati.

57094.commentary: (ANa) saṅgh'uposathan'ti aṭṭhannaṃ ariyapuggalānaṃ guṇe ārabbha upavutthattā ayaṃ uposatho saṅgh'uposatho'ti vutto.

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, visākhe, ariyasāvako saṅgh'uposathaṃ upavasati, saṅghena saddhiṃ saṃvasati, saṅghañ'c'assa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmojjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
yāvatikā ca bhikkhū kammappattā saṅgh'uposathaarahā cattāro vā tato vā atirekā pakatattā pārājikaṃ anāpannā saṅghena vā anukkhittā.

57095.meaning1: worthy of (participating in) the observance day ceremony with the community

examples.text: yāvatikā ca bhikkhū kammappattā saṅgh'uposath'ārahā cattāro vā tato vā atirekā pakatattā pārājikaṃ anāpannā saṅghena vā anukkhittā.

57096.meaning1: concerning the community; regarding the monastic order
57096.commentary: (DNa) buddh'ūpasañhitā'ti buddhaṃ ārabbha buddhaṃ nissayaṃ katvā pavattā'ti attho. sesapadesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho pañcasikho gandhabbadevaputto beluvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ assāvesi, imā ca gāthā abhāsi buddh'ūpasañhitā dhamm'ūpasañhitā saṅgh'ūpasañhitā arahant'ūpasañhitā kām'ūpasañhitā

57097.meaning1: including the world system; with the solar system
57097.meaningLit: with the circle of animals; i.e. zodiac

examples.text: sac'ajja mayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ careyyāma, vācāya sucaritaṃ careyyāma, manasā sucaritaṃ careyyāma, evaṃ mayaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyāma.

57099.meaning1: if he; if one; if this

examples.text: sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ek'aṃsabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ek'aṃsena byākaroti, vibhajjabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na vibhajja byākaroti, paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na paṭipucchā byākaroti, ṭhapanīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ṭhapeti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.

khat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. upahat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā pitaraṃ dhammikaṃ dhammarājānaṃ jīvitā na voropessatha, imasmiññ'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ uppajjissathā'ti.
